title_en: SLINGSHOT — GRAVITY ASSISTS & THE GRAND TOUR
description: An interactive field guide to gravity assists: why a spacecraft leaves a planet exactly as fast as it arrived yet gains or loses kilometres per second relative to the Sun, the turn-angle formula checked against Cassini's 1999 Earth flyby, why it is not free energy (the planet pays), braking toward Mercury, escaping the Solar System via Jupiter, and Voyager 2's twelve-year Grand Tour versus a thirty-year direct flight.
og: Same speed in and out, yet 5.5 km/s gained: gravity assists, the planet that pays, and Voyager 2's Grand Tour — interactive and sourced from NASA, JPL and the flyby literature.
brand: SLINGSHOT — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
